title: Paginate GET /api/items with limit and offset
task: Add pagination to GET /api/items via two optional query parameters: limit (integer 1-100, default 20) and offset (integer >= 0, default 0). The response stays a JSON array containing the items from position offset, at most limit of them, in insertion order; an offset past the end yields an empty array. If limit or offset is present but is not an integer or is out of range, respond 400 with a JSON body of the shape { "error": "<message>" }. Do not add dependencies.
